renderSubstitution.note: sim-only vs fully-rendered run of an identical stimulus; a non-zero divergence invalidates every render:false trace in this report

agreementWithScreenshotRig.note: no shots/report.json to compare against in this run

initialResults.threshold: within ±5% of 1.9 / 5.4 / 7.2 m/s
initialResults.detail: all three speeds inside ±5%

initialResults.threshold: 180° heading change ≤ 250 ms; no input-ignored window > 100 ms
initialResults.detail: all reversals completed

initialResults.threshold: planted-foot world drift ≤ 2 cm per frame
initialResults.detail: 187 contact samples across walk/run/sprint

initialResults.threshold: zero frames with the near plane inside a collider; no single-frame pull-in > 1.5 m
initialResults.detail: inside-geometry is a conservative proxy: a solid collider within one near-plane radius of the eye

initialResults.threshold: both bodies inside the central 80% for ≥ 95% of the encounter; target never leaves frame
initialResults.detail: includes a scripted back-into-a-corner leg

initialResults.threshold: target centroid moves ≤ 4% of frame width from shake alone
initialResults.detail: the ablation pair did not stay in lockstep, so the difference is not attributable to shake

initialResults.threshold: ≥ 60% of enemy deaths follow a posture break, over ≥ 20 scripted encounters
initialResults.detail: played by the harness bot policy, not by a human — this is not a play test

initialResults.threshold: simultaneous attack commitment inside the authored token limit for ≥ 95% of the encounter
< 1% of ≥ 100 camera drags produce an unintended slash or press; no gesture starts inside the OS edge margin
initialResults.detail: every drag is authored outside the flick and tap envelopes, so anything it fires is unintended by construction

initialResults.threshold: a touch event is consumed by game state in the frame it arrives; never deferred more than one frame
visible startup ≥ 140 ms (EnemyAI REACTION_FLOOR) for every enemy attack
initialResults.detail: startup taken from first frame of weapon-hand motion above 3× the idle floor

initialResults.threshold: weapon-active frames coincide with the visible blade sweep within one frame at both ends
no non-interactive sequence longer than 5 s outside the title beat; every such beat is skippable
initialResults.detail: measured from a fresh boot with the intro deliberately NOT skipped. A non-zero displacement during the title beat means the beat never took control away, so skippability does not arise for it.

initialResults.threshold: the bell cannot be rung by accident during combat movement, and its consequence is signalled before the wave commits
initialResults.detail: the deliberate half of the scenario produced nothing either: the bell was never struck even when the mapped interact intent was pressed, so it is unreachable in play rather than protected

initialResults.threshold: from every spawn and approach point, ≥ 1 navigational landmark is visible
initialResults.detail: visibility = inside the frustum at eye height and not occluded on a ray to the landmark anchor; it does not judge whether the silhouette reads

initialResults.threshold: measured luma difference across the enemy edge in every combat framing
initialResults.detail: measurement did not run

initialResults.threshold: ≤ -1 dBFS true peak with five simultaneous impacts plus the full bed
initialResults.detail: this is a SAMPLE peak taken post-limiter through an AnalyserNode, with a 4× interpolated estimate beside it. It is not an ITU-R BS.1770 true-peak meter and must not be recorded as one.

initialResults.threshold: ≤ 5 ms JS per frame at MEDIUM (ARCHITECTURE.md §7)
initialResults.detail: Measured in a container, not on a phone — the absolute milliseconds are not device evidence. What is device-independent is the shape: the whole static world is a handful of triangle-mesh colliders totalling ~2.1k triangles, and three engaged enemies drive hundreds of thousands of narrow-phase triangle tests in a single frame.

selfCheckControlSupplement.method: Post-run association of two unmodified independently recorded reports by build fingerprint; not an original in-run control.
selfCheckControlSupplement.scope: Both pipelines reported positive actual draws and comparable geometry counts. Exact counter equality and identical scene state are not claimed. Future captures resolve the matching tagged file in-run.

limits: The two versions use different harness policies and metrics; differences are not identical-stimulus A/B treatment effects.
The 120-frame determinism/render-substitution comparison passed in both versions. The tagged screenshot file was not linked by the original self-check; original reports remain unchanged.
Official reference stills are being inspected by an independent version-blind model critic; this is not a human study.
Software rendering and container CPU times are not phone frame-rate, boot or thermal evidence.
Sample audio peak is not an ITU true-peak result; its initial metric PASS must not be promoted to verified BM-AUDIO-03.
